scope: Windows local internal use; not a public release or an authorship guarantee

attribution.interpretation: CORRECT checks the raw content/tool/request link; this is not a causal oracle for an unobserved identical human rewrite.
attribution.falseAttribution: No incorrect observed content/tool/request link in audited samples. Same-byte human rewrite during tool interval remains indistinguishable and may display MEDIUM; causal false attribution is not ruled out.

split.independentVerifier: New local shared clone populated from HEAD blobs; git apply --check and apply, then exact-byte SHA-256 and file-set comparison
split.snapshotNote: Final source/docs before addition of these evidence records. Evidence records themselves were not part of this snapshot.

privacy.retention: Cache, exports and temporary verification copies are retained, unencrypted; no automated cleanup.

regressions.meaninglessMixedFileWarning: PASS; independent edits split, incompatible replacements stop

limits: No HIGH confidence or guarantee of final writer
Only supported static edit formats; no dynamic or conditional patch execution inference
Exact HEAD and sequential patch order; shifted-base apply success is not final-hash proof
Binary, >4 MiB, special modes/links omitted only with explicit --text-only
Unmerged index and staged-delete/untracked-name overlaps unsupported; guards not exercised with staged live data
Private local cache and temporary copy retention not managed
